title: George Walker at Suez
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "George Walker at Suez" by Anthony Trollope is a short story written during the mid-19th century, specifically in the Victorian era.
longDescription: This work chronicles the experiences of George Walker, a somewhat unremarkable Englishman, during his week-long visit to the town of Suez, Egypt.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
